title: Relay contract records a failed review on a started item
findings_note: s328 and s323 relays 2026-10-17: contract v5 says a failed review is `slicer reject`, but handoff now runs after PASS, so the item is `started` at review time and reject refuses it ("only review work can be rejected")
boundary: **Not in this slice:** changing `reject`'s status rule, or when handoff runs.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Contract v5 moved the note and handoff to after `VERDICT: PASS`. Its review step still tells the orchestrator to record a failed review with `slicer reject`, which needs the item in review. Every v1.14 relay with a FAIL round skipped the record, so the item's history no longer shows review failures.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/ai.py`: the relay and relay-orchestrator text for a failed review: record it as a `slicer note ID --text "Review FAIL: ..." --render` on the started item (with a `--kind` only when `note_kinds` configures one for reviews), not `reject`.
- `tests/test_ai.py`; `docs/agents.md` if it repeats the step; `CHANGELOG.md`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - `test_AiRelayOrchestrator_FailedReview_NoReject`: the orchestrator text names no `slicer reject` for a review FAIL, and names the note command.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the test; watch it go red.
2. Reword the step; bump the contract marker only if the meaning of the contract changes (it does: v6), and update the pinned marker tests.
3. CHANGELOG; mutation-check.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3.12 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
